label: Late-episode D1 after a rare a2->S1 transition
explanation: Fires only at D1, only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (99.8% of activations at ep_trial 90-99, none before 80; equivalently only when the value head is low, <5.2, which happens at the episode end), and almost only when the previous trial was a2 that reached S1 through a rare transition (92% of mass). It never fires at GO or D2, and almost never after a1 or after a common transition. Starting the window at ep_trial>=93 gives the best dev F1 (0.79; >=90 gives F1 0.70 with mass recall 0.92), so it ramps up as the episode end nears. In the top-activating examples the previous rare a2->S1 trial was rewarded (r1 at D1), but conditioning on prev_reward==1 loses most of the recall, so the reward is not required. Misses are scattered weak activations (D1 fixation errors, some after common trials). Uses only observed variables: previous choice/transition/reward and elapsed time in the episode.
